title: Controls Database Backup and Restore Conditions — Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Controls Database Backup and Restore Conditions — Building Automation Service Plans

**Clause 1 — Backup frequency and retention.** Under the Building Automation Service Plans the controls database is backed up off site at the frequency the plan's tier sets and each backup is retained for the tier's retention period, counted in calendar months.

**Clause 2 — Restore service.** Restoring a controls database from backup is included where the tier includes restore service; where it is not included the tier's restore service fee applies.

| Tier | Off-site backup frequency | Backup retention (calendar months) | Restore service | Restore fee where not included (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | none | 0 | not included | 1450 |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | quarterly | 12 | not included | 1250 |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | monthly | 24 | included | 0 |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | monthly | 36 | included | 0 |
| Remote Optimization Plan | weekly | 36 | included | 0 |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | daily | 60 | included | 0 |

**Clause 3 — Reading of the table.** A tier with a backup frequency of none takes no off-site backup and therefore has a retention of 0 months. At the four tiers where restore service is included, the restore fee column reads 0 USD.

**Hypothetical case.** A building under the Alarm Monitoring Plan holds quarterly backups retained for 12 months; a restore requested at that tier is not included and carries 1250 USD. The same request under the Scheduled Controls Service Plan is included at no charge.
